title: 명예교수규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00141:20120229:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 141, February 29, 2012>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation: Provided, That the amended provisions of Article 3 relating to assistant professors shall enter into force on July 22, 2012.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Period of Service as Full-Time Lecturer) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 3, periods of service as a full-time lecturer under the former provisions shall be deemed periods of service as an assistant professor under the amended provisions.
